outcome: Prevalence of ECV use among hospitals
cohort: The study involved 41 out of 43 Portuguese state-owned hospitals with maternity services.
finding: External Cephalic Version (ECV) is offered in a minority (39%) of Portuguese public hospitals, primarily due to lack of experience and safe conditions, with most centers expressing interest in hands-on training.
mod_finding: Reported success rates for ECV procedures ranged from 25% to 85% in the hospitals that perform the technique.
